name: Soldier, Nomex full gloves

hands.why: the arms model's own hands (an average adult hand)

covering.why: the flyer's glove spec's thickest palm leather: MIL-DTL-81188C (2001) 3.3.1, the palm and finger-palm leather 'not less than 1 1/4 ounces nor more than 2 1/2 ounces at any place in the finished glove' (ASTM D1814); 1 oz of leather = 1/64 inch, so 0.050 to 0.099 cm; the thickest end is used so a clip never passes for a touch. The back is a meta-aramid knit of 9-10 oz/sq yd (3.3.3), no thickness given; it is not on the touching side
covering.source: MIL-DTL-81188C, Gloves, Flyers', Summer, Type GS/FRP-2 (2001), 3.3.1 and 3.3.3

sources: the user's choice: full gloves, Nomex (2026-10-16)
the sleeves' coyote tan is a placeholder pick (no sleeve was chosen), to set the gloves apart
